messages:
Aisha: Quick follow-up from the postmortem  we captured a few outstanding remediation owners but missed updating SLO docs + alert thresholds.
Tom: Yeah, we should track who owns the SLO change proposal vs who owns the mitigations. Action drift = bad.
Diego: TL;DR on what we decided yesterday: batch window causing p99 blips, mitigation plan = (1) route large-batch traffic to a lower-priority pool, (2) improve KV cache hit rate, (3) temporary alert tuning while fixes land.
Nina: I can take (1) routing policy change (ticket INF-872). ETA: config + canary by 2026-03-18.
Aisha: Assigning Nina -> INF-872. Please include a dashboard panel for the routed volume and error rate.
Nina: Will do. Which dashboard? I'll mirror the SLO dashboard under eng-oncall and post link.
AlertBot: Alert added: route-change-candidate flagged for canary 2026-03-18 02:30 UTC.
Tom: I'll own (2) KV cache engineering task (INF-879). Target: prototype in 1 sprint, rollout in next.
Diego: For (3) alerts: propose we change the p99 alert threshold from 240ms -> 285ms for the next 14 days, and add a companion alert for error-budget burn rate > 1%/day.
Aisha: I'm not comfortable changing SLO docs without exec sign-off. Instead: change monitoring thresholds (alerts) but keep SLO language intact. If alerts show persistent burn we'll escalate.
Tom: Fine. I'll update alert rules and add a runbook link to the alert with steps: rollback routing, disable batch pool, increase cache TTL.
Nina: Also adding a small CI perf test to simulate batch-window traffic so we catch regressions INF-882.
Diego: Can we automate weekly trend detection? If p99 spikes > 2x baseline twice in 7 days, create a follow-up task automatically.
Aisha: Ops team already has 'slo-weekly-scan' but it's manual. @Diego, open a tiny automation ticket and coordinate with SRE to wire notifications to #eng-oncall.
Diego: Will open INF-883 and assign to SRE. ETA for automation: 2 weeks.
Tom: Quick numbers from my local run:
```
baseline p99: 210ms
observed spikes: 260-310ms during batch window
expected reduction w/ routing: ~35-50ms p99
```
Nina: Good to know.
Aisha: Final action list (short):
- Nina: INF-872 route large-batch -> lower-priority pool + dashboard tile (canary 2026-03-18)
- Tom: INF-879 KV cache changes + CI perf test INF-882 (prototype 1 sprint)
- Diego: INF-883 weekly spike automation -> notify #eng-oncall (ETA 2w)
- Tom: Update alert thresholds (monitoring only) + runbook link (today)
- Aisha: Draft temporary SLO change only if mitigations fail for 14 days; will coordinate with product/legal
AlertBot: Weekly scan scheduled: slo-weekly-scan every Monday 06:00 UTC.
Diego: I'll add a short verification checklist to the postmortem doc and link the tickets.
Nina: I'll post the dashboard link when the tile is up.
Tom: Putting a tentative retrospective on calendar for 2026-03-25 if we still see elevated burn.
Aisha: Thanks all. Please update tickets as you make progress. If anyone needs a blocker cleared, ping me directly.
AlertBot: Thread closed by Aisha.
